title: Experts disagree on .github/workflows/plugin-eval.yml
context:
Chief architect: the three claims come from one seat and do not oppose each other; this is the invocation shape the settled design notes fix and the only one that names --scaffold, without which no fixture exists; the pinned-version claim is carried by accepted EX-devops-engineer-2 and EX-security-auditor-8, and the exit-code handling by EX-security-auditor-5

Target: .github/workflows/plugin-eval.yml
- integration-architect: the job treats eval exit code 2 (partial, cost ceiling) and 130/143 (interrupted) as a failed run, and exit 1 under --threshold 0 as a load failure, so no partial result is ever reported as a pass
- integration-architect: CI installs a pinned Claude Code version and prints it in the log, because case.yaml, grader targets, scaffold rules and the --json shape were probed on one version (2.1.302 locally, 2.1.269 in the issue) and an unpinned upgrade can change the contract between weekly runs
- integration-architect: each suite runs as its own invocation with --tag and its own --allow-tools (routing none, firewall Edit Write, receipt Edit Write Bash), plus --trust-plugin, --no-publish, --scaffold and an explicit --max-cost-usd, writing one JSON and one HTML report per suite, all uploaded as artifacts even when the gate fails
